releases.author: heidihelena
releases.description:
First public release. Apache-2.0.

A sprint starts by naming one research decision and a finish condition, and ends by recording what changed in your argument: claims written, sources linked, assumptions made visible, questions opened, paths ruled out. Each reviewed sprint becomes a dated note in your vault, and daily and weekly summaries are written from those records.

The plugin reads your notes and writes only its own records. It has no rename or move calls anywhere in the source, so it cannot reclassify a note or move one between folders. That judgement stays yours. It makes no network requests: no telemetry, no account, no external service.

Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
